name: @local/dsh-wx-chat
description: WeChat-style chat layout for the DeepSeek Harness conversation: user bubbles right with avatar, DeepSeek bubbles left. Adds per-turn tool/type avatars, a labeled roleplay-avatar entry with per-turn mode boundaries, tabbed settings, a size/appearance preview modal with restore, a standalone centered crop modal, click-to-preview, solid/transparent avatar backgrounds, GIF support, in-bubble scrolling for wide markdown tables with contrast-safe custom bubble colours, high-resolution crop export (up to 1024px) with a size budget, bubble-aware inline-code colours, per-turn avatar history (IndexedDB), and shareable per-session avatar schemes (create/copy/rename/delete/import/export, one scheme per session). Presentation-only UI layer.
